**Returns:**

A Hono app to mount (the macts server mounts it at `/api/v1`<!-- -->).

## Remarks

Registers, relative to wherever the returned app is mounted:

- `POST /rpc/<id>` for each operation registered on the runtime when the adapter is built, except one whose descriptor is marked `unavailable`<!-- -->. The body is the operation's input record in wire form (a missing or blank body is `{}`<!-- -->); `Authorization: Bearer <token>` carries the credential; `X-Request-Id` optionally supplies the correlation id. Success is `200 { result }`<!-- -->; failure is the D6 error envelope with the status from [httpStatusForError()](./api.httpstatusforerror.md)<!-- -->, plus `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` for `UNAUTHENTICATED` and `Retry-After` for `RATE_LIMITED`<!-- -->. - `GET /introspect`<!-- -->: the first registered app's operations with their manifest descriptions, parameters, and return types. - `GET /introspect/all`<!-- -->: every registered app's operations.

Any other route, including `POST /rpc/<unregistered id>` and the route of an unavailable operation, is a 404 whose code `NOT_FOUND` is deliberately outside the error registry, and never reaches the runtime. Operations registered on the runtime after this call are not routed.
